Six boxes are marked (Required) and they are boxes 1 to 6: I located the six '(Required)' markers at x[74.75,113.87] under boxes 1, 2, 3 and 4 in the left column and at x[259.20,298.33] under boxes 5 and 6 in the middle column, and page 2 carries none. The agency headings resolve to the numbers the guide gives them - 'Police' above box 7 in column 2, 'Human Services' above box 9, 'Health' above box 10, 'Natural Resources' above box 11, 'MN Driver and Vehicle Services' at box 12 in column 3 - so the guide's warning that the MN Department of Human Services / Office of Inspector General is box 9 and not one of the six Required is right. Box 13 is MN State Patrol on page 2 with its own printed address, and the guide correctly counts it among the nine conditional boxes. Every service statement the guide makes is verbatim from the committed track registry, and nothing on EXP104 is filled but the caption, which the guide explains: a proof of service certifies a mailing that has not happened.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: 59 items are declared requiredBeforeFiling and all 59 are disclosed - I tested every disclosure label as a byte substring of the delivered guide and none was missing - but one blank the form itself requires is not among them and is named nowhere in participant copy. FEE102 page 1 item 2 prints 'Choose one:' and offers two branches: 'I am including my pleadings with this Affidavit (or I have already filed my pleadings but have not yet paid the filing fee)' and 'I only want to have copy fees waived. I do not have any pleadings to file at this time.' On the delivered page 20 both branches are empty - the page carries exactly one ink cluster, the caption defendant name at x[74.88,164.16] - so the affidavit goes out with the choose-one unanswered. The election is classified into protectedBlanks under the identifier pleadings_or_copy_fees_election, whose own recorded reason says 'which of the two the participant is asking for is theirs to choose', and it is therefore not in the requiredBeforeFiling set the guide prints from. The words 'pleadings', 'copy fee' and 'Choose one' do not occur anywhere in participant-instructions.md, and the guide's FEE102 supply table lists items 3, 4/5, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11-13 and 14 and the declaration block - every item on the form except item 2. FEE101, the fee-waiver instruction sheet the form's own header points to, is not in this packet either, so nothing the participant receives tells them the choice exists. This is the same defect shape FIX07 repaired on de_pardon_expungement-set and on the sibling mn_petition_15218-set: a choice the court's own form requires, classified into a bucket the disclosure list does not print from, and named nowhere the participant will read.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.detail: The route's own election is correct and disclosed. This packet ticks nothing: 21 ink clusters across 25 pages and not one is a checkbox mark. That is the right answer for item 9, because the route settles the subdivision and not the clause, and the guide makes the participant's task explicit as a numbered step - 'Choose your qualification clause at item 9 of EXP102 yourself' - then prints all eight subdivision-3 clauses in the form's own words with the waiting period the committed registry records for each, and separately declares the three off-route options NOT_APPLICABLE_ON_THIS_ROUTE with the redirection each prints on its own face. The one election that is offered nowhere, FEE102 item 2, is recorded once under REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and is counted once in requiredOptionsMissing rather than failed twice here.

REPEATING_ROWS.detail: Two repeating structures arise, so this is a real measurement. EXP102 item 7 is a six-row criminal-record table with six columns - Case #, County-State, Type of Charge, Conviction Yes/No, Date of Offense, Date of Conviction - and EXP104 carries the fifteen-box service list. Both are delivered entirely empty: EXP102 page 3 is pixel-identical to its source and EXP104's two pages carry only the caption defendant name. The AcroForm-index-versus-printed-row trap cannot arise because there are no AcroForm fields anywhere in this packet; rows and boxes are addressed by measured geometry, and I re-measured the service list's fifteen printed numerals myself and found the field map's page attributions correct. Both structures are disclosed: item 7 gets one guide entry per printed row, all six, and the service list gets a box-by-box account.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: Nothing is fabricated and no figure is invented. The guide states the fee rule in the record's own words - 'A district court filing fee applies unless a statutory fee waiver or a granted FEE102 waiver applies' - then says the record states no figure and tells the participant to ask the district court administrator. The waiver limb is the record's too: 'FEE102 Affidavit to Request Fee Waiver, with FEE103 where the court requests further detail. A statutory fee waiver applies to certain petitions', with the guide correctly adding that FEE102 is in the packet and FEE103 is not. I confirmed both quotations byte for byte in the digest-bound track registry. FEE102's six delivered pages carry no financial value at all - pages 21 to 24 are pixel-identical to their source - and the guide explains that none of what the affidavit asks for is held by the platform. The failure recorded above is about FEE102 item 2's undisclosed choose-one and not about the fee or the waiver statements, which are sound.
